title: PASS (round focus a): goldens/, .dem/.log.bin, core/, and harness/ are all untouched — T1/T2/replay stay byte-identical
evidence: grep '^diff --git' diff.patch → only: .gitignore, _bmad-output/field-notes/packet-plumber-v2-ambience.md, _bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-ambience-bed.md, _bmad-output/reviews/v2-ambience/{blind-hunter,edge-case,review-diff,verif-gap}.txt, _pr_body_ambience.md, app/audio/audio.odin, app/audio/audio_test.odin, app/main.odin, assets/audio/README.md, assets/audio/ambience_loop.ogg, tools/build_ambience_loop.py. Additionally: grep -n "bed_\|MUSIC_" harness/run.odin → no matches; consumer_consume has no hunk in the diff.

title: PASS (round focus b): bed load/play is fully behind the device_on gate — headless/CI survives 'no audio device'
detail: audio_init early-returns before load_bed() when IsAudioDeviceReady() is false, so no raylib stream call ever runs headless; bed_update/bed_envelope_step/bed_duck_trigger all early-return on !bed_on, and the harness mirror never calls bed_update.

detail: The duck is a post-play trigger appended to audio_flush; the append-only event tags remain the SFX path and consumer_consume/Pending are untouched. The #81 system is not rebuilt.

title: PASS (round focus d, parts 1-3): committed asset is the compressed OGG (913,706 bytes), hash matches the pin, no .wav tracked, .gitignore covers the WAV form
evidence: ls: "-rw-r--r--@ 1 moses  staff  913706 23 Aug 08:04 ambience_loop.ogg"; ffprobe: "codec_name=vorbis / sample_rate=48000 / channels=2 / duration=125.600000 / size=913706"; shasum -a 256: "7fdb30925eba3f8490895742a69ffebba16643d2ebd4f5dfe5cf88329a06d609  assets/audio/ambience_loop.ogg" (matches the README/PR-body pin); git ls-files | grep -i '\.wav$' → empty; .gitignore: "assets/audio/ambience_loop.wav"
detail: The 35MB vault WAV is not committed anywhere, the 24MB intermediate path is gitignored, and the committed OGG is byte-identical to the documented sha256 pin.

title: FAIL (round focus d, pin conjunct): the transform pins sha256 of the OUTPUT only — the input vault WAV is never hashed, so 'reproducible from the same source' is unverifiable from repo artifacts
evidence:
sha = hashlib.sha256(open(OUT_OGG, "rb").read()).hexdigest()
print(f"wrote {OUT_OGG} ({os.path.getsize(OUT_OGG)/1e6:.2f}MB)")
print(f"sha256: {sha}")  — this is the only hashlib use in the script; SRC ("/Users/moses/code/_local-refs/audio/Warm Analog Drift.wav") is opened only via wave.open, never hashed. README pins only the output: "Committed artifact hash: `7fdb30925eba3f8490895742a69ffebba16643d2ebd4f5dfe5cf88329a06d609` (verify with `shasum -a 256 assets/audio/ambience_loop.ogg`)".
detail: The mechanical check requires sha256 of input/output; the ffmpeg params are fixed and the output pin verifies, but no input hash exists anywhere, so a swapped/edited vault WAV would silently produce a different 'reproducible' artifact.
recommended_fix: After the source guards, compute and print hashlib.sha256 of the SRC bytes (or raw frames) and record that input hash beside the output hash in assets/audio/README.md.

title: pending_any_plays doc comment overpromises: the flush's play loops do not key off it, so a fifth family CAN still silently miss the duck
detail: The helper is called only by the duck trigger; a future fifth play family requires editing both the play loops and this helper, exactly the lockstep hazard the comment claims is eliminated. Code is correct today; the comment misstates the invariant.
recommended_fix: Reword the comment to state the helper must be updated when a play family is added, or have the play loops/key families derive from a shared table so the single-source claim is true.

evidence: - `odin test app/audio` → 17/17 (13 pre-existing + 4 new bed tests).  — vs app/audio/audio_test.odin, which has 17 test procs: 10 pre-existing (test_consumer_crisis_draw:16 … test_consumer_spawn_draw:224) and 7 new bed tests (test_bed_envelope_shape:240, test_bed_duck_retrigger:272, test_bed_off_is_silent_noop:288, test_bed_duck_never_raises:300, test_bed_paused_ducked_level:313, test_bed_retrigger_while_deep:326, test_bed_mute_mirror_flag:342).

title: tools/build_ambience_loop.py introduces an undocumented numpy dependency (only ffmpeg is documented)
evidence:
import numpy as np  — and the docstring documents only: "Requires ffmpeg with a vorbis encoder (`-strict -2` for the experimental
native encoder on homebrew builds)."  — grep -rn "numpy" tools/ → only "tools/build_ambience_loop.py:31:import numpy as np"; no requirements.txt or README mention of numpy.
detail: The transform is not CI-gated so nothing breaks, but a maintainer re-running it on a fresh machine hits an undocumented ModuleNotFoundError; the README's reproducibility section also omits the Python deps.
recommended_fix: Add 'Requires python3 + numpy' to the script docstring and the README reproducibility section (or vendor a requirements line in tools/).
